raw_response:
I will keep my farm simple and steady. I have only 9 mu, and I have farmed for many years, so I will not spread myself too thin on the riskier crops. I will keep wheat-maize as my main system on 6 mu because that is the most familiar and dependable way for me to use my land through the whole year. I will put 2 mu into cotton because I still want some cash crop income, but I will not expand it too much because cotton needs labor and careful field management. I will keep watermelon to 1 mu because it can bring cash, but it is riskier and needs more water, pesticide, and attention, so I will keep it small enough that my household can manage it well. Since I have well irrigation, I will irrigate at the key times rather than too often. I will use better seed where it helps yield and stability, but I will keep fertilizer and pesticide at levels I believe I can afford and manage. My goal is stable output, manageable labor, and not taking on more risk than my small farm can carry.
